scope: single-host two-replica engineering qualification using the measured stock 256-row configuration; loopback client implements routing, independent authentication per replica, synthetic tools
cases: withdraw old replica from routing while final answer is streaming, then retire it after drain
start a replacement on released GPU and admit only after readiness
interrupt the other owned replica during its final answer, reject the incomplete stream, recover with explicit new request
repeat the same logical tool operations with durable idempotency keys
route after rollback to the recovered original configuration
excluded: node power/network fault, multi-node rollout and customer canary require a real target; measurements here are process failures
